# 5 bed site for sale

> A rare opportunity in the heart of Old Foxrock. Set on a mature site extending to approximately one third of an acre, this exceptional property presents a unique opportunity to create a substantial new family home on one of Foxrock's most prestigious residential avenues. Full planning permission has been secured for a detached five-bedroom residence extending to approximately 250 sq.m. (2,700 sq.
